propositions: Authors must document risky runtime mechanisms and commit to fast out-of-loop proof (local run or manual probe) before codifying in slow delivery loops like CI/CD or IaC apply.
The packaged guide must identify de-risk-before-slow-loop guidance as T15 criterion and specify that teardown cleanup scopes only to resources created by the throwaway experiment.
Documentation must remain stack-agnostic without product-specific Terraform or Docker instructions, treating CI/CD, IaC apply, and provisioning as mechanism classes.
The hand-authored overlay enumeration in plan-review-gate.md must be updated from T1–T12 to T1–T15 with criterion count aligned to validated registry value of 44.
Registry module docstring and criterion-pins.json must be regenerated to reflect T1–T15 vocabulary and 44 total criteria in sync with gate documentation.
rebar explain plan command must render complete T15 guidance including slow-loop identification, fast proof forms, and scoped-cleanup boundary through the packaged guide and explain_guide surfaces.
